6680.title: Dispatch admission and replay safety
6680.rootCauseOneLine: React pending state does not synchronously guard reentry, and delegation spawns before persistence without dispatch-attempt identity or retained outcomes.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — closed, unmerged; not executed
prReviews.topFinding: The proposed durable attempt contract targets the demonstrated mechanisms, but changes schema and stored state across 12 files; outside this rule's simple-fix limits. No exhaustive correctness review.

6680.proposedFix: Use synchronous UI admission plus explicit attempt identity and durable replay/unknown-outcome semantics across UI, RPC, and CLI. No automatic PR: a complete repair exceeds the no-schema/no-stored-data/no-architecture-decision limits.
6680.caveats: Real Tasks UI/handlers and plugin SQLite; RPC transport and SDK thread effects are surrogates. Four desired-behavior failures repeated in two clean trusted checkouts. No live browser, real provider, or crash recovery test. Full reproduction patch is inline in the HTML.
